identifier.value: Polymesh Labs acquired by Polymath Network

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Polymath Network is researching distributed cryptographic tokens with downstream administrative control, focusing on platforms that enable centralized control over updates to a distributed cryptocurrency network by including administrative users and separate rule sets. Additionally, they are developing methods and systems for private identity verification, which use cryptographically secure commitments to protect user identifiers. These areas reflect their work at the intersection of blockchain, security, and identity.

press_references.value: Polymath Launches Confidential Assets on Polymesh, Bringing Institutional-Grade Privacy to Tokenization

product_launches.description: Polymath launched Confidential Assets, a native protocol-layer privacy feature on the Polymesh blockchain, enabling institutions to transact tokenized securities and real-world assets privately on a public chain while maintaining regulatory visibility and compliance.

press_references.value: Russell Young Partners with Polymath to Tokenize Iconic Autographed Pelé Art Collection, Expanding Access to Blue-Chip Art Ownership

product_launches.description: Polymath launched access to Russell Young's tokenized Pelé Collection through the Polymath Capital Platform, offering qualified participants ownership interests in the seven-piece autographed art series as a new alternative investment product.

overview_description.description: Polymath Network (Polymath) is a decentralized protocol that makes it easier to raise capital and create security tokens. The Security Token Standard, ERC-1400, embeds regulatory requirements into the tokens themselves, restricting trading to verified participants only. The protocol simplifies the complex technical challenges of creating a security token and aims to bring the multi-trillion dollar financial securities market to the blockchain.

product.name: Polymath Capital Platform

product.name: Polymesh Blockchain
product.description: A purpose-built blockchain for regulated assets, providing identity verification, on-chain compliance, governance, confidentiality, and settlement for tokenized securities.

product.name: Polymath Token Studio
product.description: A user interface for creating, issuing, and managing compliant security tokens, with configurable token features and blockchain integration.

product.description: A managed service that lets organizations operate a Polymath or Polymesh blockchain node without deploying and maintaining the required technical infrastructure themselves.
